newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Corp approves declassification of shrs.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Corp approves declassification of shrs.

text.p: Conglomerate Ayala Corp said on Tuesday its board of directors approved the declassification of its A and B shares that would result in one price.
Class B shares had historically been more expensive than the A shares because foreigners could only buy the B shares.
The move to declassify the shares was in response to a market reform programme of the Securities and Exchange Commission and the Philippine Stock Exchange, the firm said.

Based on the new share structure, "fluctuations or differences in prices are eliminated for two classes of stocks that represent the same economic rights and interest in the listed company," Ayala said in a statement.
The company said it would present its proposal to stockholders in a meeting to be called within six weeks.
